source.relative_path: 2018美赛特等奖/E题7篇/E88902-A Probabilistic Model of the Relationships between Countries and Climate Change.pdf

source_quality.notes: the three normalizations, the two climate equations and the Markov product were read from the raster; the entropy lines and the time step were read from the text layer

task_reconstruction: Score how much one country suffers from climate change, tie that score to four fragility groups with a network that looks sideways inside a year and forward across years, and name the band where the climate score still moves the rest.

section_map.summary: the growing urgency and the conceded gap
the dated first link and the numbered aims
the bare assumptions and the drifted acronyms
the overlap, the filled year and the three scalings
the climate index and the country score
the inner network and the product
the curves and the warning zone
the chosen country and the yearly spend
the unfixed strength and the echoed weakness

contributions.summary: a country climate score built by shrinking a global index with a published vulnerability
an undirected network inside one year joined to a directed step across years
a warning zone read off the posterior-mean curves
a fragile-vulnerable boundary taken as the mean of the two smaller centres

dependency_graph.relation: the normalized indicators are what the climate index weights
the normalized indicators are what the entropy is computed on
the weights build the four fragility nodes
the country score is the fifth node
the forecast indicators are what the clustering labels

assumptions.summary: the data are reliable and no large-scale war breaks out
the productive forces and the social structure hold for recent years
the four fragility categories weigh the same for now
the next year depends only on the current year

data_and_preprocessing.summary: fragility for 178 countries over twelve years, climate for 111, overlap of seven years
the missing year filled by the mean of its two neighbours
indicators sorted into bigger-is-better, smaller-is-better and fixed-best

models.summary: the climate index and the country score

verification.summary: the effect read off the posterior-mean curves
each learned link scored by a divergence and a correlation
the model run on one fragile country

results_trace.summary: the climate score moves the four indicators only inside the band from zero to 0.2
the climate-to-economy link is the weakest, at 0.2646 and 0.2602
the six interventions add up to 14.18 million dollars a year
the chosen country is forecast to turn fragile in 2016

writing_logic.summary: a shortcoming is conceded and called sufficient in the same sentence
a rhetorical question sets a valued property aside
a borrowed maxim limits the claim
an odd peak is admitted before any excuse

language_observations.summary: opens by calling the task more and more imperative
concedes the data is incomplete and calls it sufficient
names a region of a curve the warning zone
opens a confession with frankly speaking

visualization_observations.summary: the climate index is drawn as a donut of factor and result indicators
the inner network is drawn as five nodes with three edges
the posterior means are drawn as curves with a low band marked off
the continents are drawn as maps coloured by a weighted index

judge_relevance_hypotheses.summary: conceding the data is short and then calling it sufficient reads as candour about a thin sample
admitting the odd peak is hard to interpret reads as a paper that owns an opaque result

weaknesses.summary: the acronym rows drift, so the symbols pick up the wrong expansions
the forecast table scrambles the two years
the cluster centres sit far above the zero-to-one scale
the entropy formula is garbled and the trajectory rule is never printed

independent_extensions.summary: name the band of a curve where the effect still holds and say it fades outside
join an undirected snapshot inside one period to a directed step across periods

unresolved_questions: the sentence before the product names a coefficient, a feature function and factors the product does not contain
the prose says seven pairwise factors but the list shows four, and the last pair names the wrong node
the acronym table pairs the symbols with the wrong expansions
the cluster centres sit above the scale of the indicators
